exposure.needed: whether any client or tooling lists Strimzi Pod-restart events using a regardingObject field-selector that names the Pod

consequence.statement: Event listings that use a `regardingObject` field selector naming the Pod will no longer match Pod-restart events. The selector must be updated to name the Kafka resource instead.
consequence.remediation: Update any `regardingObject` field selectors used to list Pod-restart events so they name the Kafka resource instead of the Pod.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer use the Pod as their `regardingObject`, so anyone who filters events with a `regardingObject` field selector must change it to point at the Kafka resource.
